prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized wounded orca seen from the side, body in profile, centered,
silhouette diminished and sorrowful. Flat app-icon geometry. Body in a
confident saturated dark palette color. The dorsal fin is broken —
either bent sharply at an angle or with a visible notch cut from its
trailing edge. A tail fluke that hangs slightly lower than a healthy
orca's. Simple white scar-lines across the flank. White eye-patch
oval. Body posture is tired / drifting, not aggressive.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat app-icon illustration; modern UI icon register, Phosphor Fill aesthetic; bold vector geometry with crisp sharp edges; single centered subject on plain off-white canvas with generous padding; no gradients, no textures, no brushwork

SUBJECT: adult orca in strict side profile, body rendered as a single bold flat shape in deep saturated blue (#0000FF); dorsal fin bent sharply mid-point at a severe downward angle suggesting damage; tail fluke angled slightly downward below the body centerline conveying a tired drifting posture; white oval eye-patch (#FFFFFF) centered on the head region as a clean flat shape; two or three thin white (#FFFFFF) scar lines crossing the flank as simple straight strokes; body silhouette lean and adult-proportioned, not cartoon-stubby

CONTEXT: map icon for a wounded or diminished orca entity; isolated single icon, no scene, no background elements beyond off-white canvas

COLOR: body in deep saturated blue (#0000FF); eye-patch and scar lines in clean white (#FFFFFF); off-white canvas background

DETAILS: every shape reads as a deliberate flat fill with sharp crisp edges; dorsal fin break is a single angular bend, readable as a distinct notch at 16px scale; tail droop is subtle but legible at small sizes; no interior ink strokes, no gradient shading, no painterly marks

CONSTRAINTS: bold silhouette readable at 16px; flat filled vector geometry only; no scene dressing; no juvenile or cartoon proportions; no aging or wear on canvas
